name: worktree-guidelines
description: Guidelines-first worktree workflow. On entering a git worktree you run the `worktree-manager` skill and act as the manager: interview the user, confirm a `<lang>-guidelines` skill exists per stack (built via `guideline-builder` if not), split tasks, then launch a Workflow that runs the coder / type-check / review loop with real parallel barriers and capped rounds. Each coder loads its guideline and uses Context7 for up-to-date library docs. Use for any isolated feature work in a worktree.
